batches.prompt:
Generate a 3x3 grid of 9 flat-design icons on transparent background (PNG). Icons are numbered top-left to bottom-right, left-to-right, row by row:

1. Laptop/notebook computer, front view, flat design, dark slate-navy body (#0F172A) with a slate outline (#334155) and a near-black screen area (#070913)
2. Thick vertical wall/barrier block, solid blocky texture, rose/red color (#F43F5E) -- represents a STRONG isolation boundary
3. Thin vertical wall/barrier sliver (much slimmer than #2, same overall height, with a visible thin crack or gap line), same rose/red color (#F43F5E) -- represents a WEAK/thin isolation boundary
4. Hypervisor icon: 2-3 stacked flat hardware-abstraction layers viewed at a slight angle, violet color (#A78BFA)
5. Guest OS icon: simple computer/monitor window shape with a small gear badge overlapping one corner, orange color (#FB923C)
6. Shared kernel icon: a single gear/cog shape, sky-blue color (#38BDF8)
7. Container engine icon (GENERIC/ABSTRACT ONLY -- do NOT reproduce the real Docker whale logo or any existing trademark): a gear paired with a small container-crate silhouette, docker-brand blue color (#2496ED)
8. Container/crate icon: shipping-container-style box with corrugated horizontal panel lines on its side, green color (#34D399)
9. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist, consistent visual weight across all icons
- Use ONLY the exact hex color specified per icon (no gradients, single flat fill + optional 1 darker shade for depth)
- Each icon same overall size, clearly distinct silhouette
- High contrast against transparent background
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 3 rows x 3 columns
- Recommended total size: ~3072x3072 pixels (roughly 1024x1024 per icon before crop)
- Icons 4-8 should read clearly as small ACCENT icons (they will be placed small, inside a label box), keep silhouettes simple and bold rather than highly detailed

batches.prompt:
Generate a 1x3 row of 3 flat-design GENERIC/ABSTRACT accent icons on transparent background (PNG), numbered left to right. These must evoke the general FEEL of dev-tool badges but must NOT reproduce any real trademarked logo shape -- no exact silhouette matching, no eye/dot cutouts, no letter marks:

1. NODE ACCENT: A hexagon shape, color #68A063 (green), with a subtle darker-green (#4d7a49) smaller hexagon inset/bevel in the center to give a light 3D layered look (like a badge with a raised rim). Clean, bold, flat-shaded (not gradient-heavy).

2. PYTHON ACCENT: Two THICK ribbon/ribbon-band shapes, each curved into a rounded 'S' hook (like two chunky commas or hooks interlocking), overlapping each other to form a compact rounded-square silhouette overall. Top-left hook is solid blue (#3776AB), bottom-right hook is solid yellow (#FFD43B). The curves must be soft and organic (thick rounded ribbon, NOT thin rings, NOT full circles/donuts) so it does not read as a plain 'infinity/link' icon. Absolutely NO eye-shaped cutouts, NO dots, NO circular holes anywhere on the shape.

3. REDIS ACCENT: Three flat-faceted diamond/hexagonal-cube shapes stacked vertically with small gaps between them (like a layered database icon), all in red (#DC382D). Each layer should look slightly 3D/faceted (add one small darker-red triangular facet on the lower-right edge of each layer for depth), and the top layer should be visually slightly smaller/pointed compared to the two below it (crown-like taper), NOT three identical flat hexagons.

Style requirements:
- Flat design with light faceted/beveled shading only where specified (not full gradients)
- Bold, simple, high-contrast silhouettes -- these are small ACCENT icons (~28x28px final size)
- Use ONLY the exact hex colors specified per icon plus the 1 darker shade noted for depth
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 1 row x 3 columns
- Recommended total size: ~3072x1024 pixels (roughly 1024x1024 per icon before crop)
- CRITICAL: none of these may reproduce an existing trademarked logo's exact silhouette, proportions, or distinguishing details (no eyes/dots on icon 2, no exact hexagon-stack-with-crown-notch copy on icon 3) -- generic reinterpretation only
